Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks for the update and for looping procurement. A couple of quick checks from my side before I provision:

1) Legal name verification: Anna replies with "Pellion Systems, Inc." — please ensure the W-9 matches that exact legal name. If Pellion invoices as "Pellion Systems" (no "Inc."), it can cause our AP system to create duplicate vendor records.

2) PO signer & limits: Victor Ramos is listed as PO signer up to $50k. We need a confirmation on who can sign on behalf of Pellion for PO acceptance (digital signature acceptance is OK). If they require a wet signature for acceptance above $50k, we should note that in the vendor record.

3) Bank details & verification: If they want ACH, we require either a voided check or a bank letter. The bank_details_remit.txt is fine as preliminary, but we'll need proof for ACH provisioning.

4) Tax ID: last 4 are fine for matching, but for final onboarding we need full TIN on the W-9.

Action items: Rishi — can you confirm we request a signed W-9 that shows the full TIN and a bank proof (voided check / bank letter)? Marissa — once we have those, can you kick off vendor provisioning in Aria and set PO routing to accounts@pellion.com?

Thanks,
Karthik
